players.product: High-layer-count (30+ layer) and high-order (5-6 step) HDI PCBs for AI servers, plus high-speed boards for 800G/1.6T switches and optical modules

quarterly_data.signal: The board (meeting of August 28, 2026) approved wholly owned subsidiary Ji'an Shengyi Electronics building the 'Xinsuan Zhilian' high-speed interconnect PCB manufacturing project in existing plant space in Ji'an, Jiangxi: total investment about RMB 225,700.00 (ten-thousand) including plant already built, new investment about RMB 215,800.00 (ten-thousand), self-funded. Products: HDI PCBs for AI servers, automotive electronics and related fields; built in phases to a design capacity of 44.59 (ten-thousand square metres) per year; 36-month construction, expected start 2026/09/28, expected after-tax return 15%. The company says it will free capacity for 4-step-and-above high-end HDI; the project still needs government filing and environmental/energy approvals.

Shengyi Electronics.why: Chinese PCB maker whose AI server high-multilayer / high-order HDI boards and 800G-1.6T switch and optical-module boards drive its growth (H1 2026 revenue +53.46% on AI server and HPC demand); its stock tracks AI server board demand.
Shengyi Electronics.evidence: Shengyi Electronics 2026 half-year report: broke through 5-6 step HDI and 30+ layer boards; products passed certification by leading global computing platforms and are in large-scale batch delivery; 1.6T switch boards in small-batch mass production.
